responsibility: This file translates constant Fortran expressions into GCC tree constants for the GENERIC backend. It builds integer/real/complex/logical/character/Hollerith tree constants, converts GMP and MPFR values to and from backend nodes, initializes constant character lengths and rank constants, supports localized and wide string construction, and handles prescribed memory representations via VIEW_CONVERT_EXPR so compile-time constants are emitted with the correct target type and layout.
same_name_distinction: Implements constant lowering and conversion code: building GCC tree constants, GMP/MPFR conversions, string/character constant construction, and prescribed-representation handling. Unlike gcc/fortran/trans-const.h, it is the code that performs constant translation rather than just declaring the helpers.
